column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 16 (M24016): Ateraxis kalah lalu memilih berasimilasi dengan
# Nirvana, berubah menjadi entitas raksasa; Commander ikut terjatuh ke dasar Nirvana.
# Tetap Inggris: Nirvana, M4, M4A1, Ateraxis, Asteria, Mark of the Avenger, Mokosh,
# The Elmo, Lunasia, Mother, AR Team, Boojum, Commander, Helena, Melanie, Beluga,
# Robella, Soppo, Doll, Frame.
(It was unknown how long the near-eternal offense and defense lasted, but both sides' understanding of the Nirvana space grew exponentially with every passing second of their clash.)
column2: (Tidak diketahui berapa lama serang-tahan yang nyaris abadi itu berlangsung, tapi pemahaman kedua pihak atas ruang Nirvana bertambah secara eksponensial di setiap detik benturan mereka.)

column1: (The accumulating damage on the Dolls, including M4, eventually left their frames battered and scarred. However, on the other side, Ateraxis, despite appearing unscathed on the outside due to her regenerative abilities, fell to her knees first.)
column2: (Kerusakan yang menumpuk pada para Doll, termasuk M4, akhirnya membuat frame mereka remuk dan penuh luka. Namun di sisi lain, Ateraxis yang dari luar tampak tanpa cela karena daya regenerasinya justru lebih dulu bersimpuh.)

column1: (Just as she said herself, Nirvana is the only place where we can defeat her.)
column2: (Seperti yang dia katakan sendiri, Nirvana satu-satunya tempat kami bisa mengalahkannya.)
——Eh?

column1: Why... can't I stand up?
column2: Kenapa... aku tidak bisa berdiri?

column1: 这是怎么回事……
column2: Ada apa ini...

column1: First time? This is the feeling of being 'finished'. Your regeneration isn't created from nothing; after continuously consuming energy here, there will eventually be an end, right?
column2: Pertama kali? Ini rasanya 'habis'. Regenerasimu bukan diciptakan dari kekosongan; setelah terus menghabiskan energi di sini, akhirnya akan ada ujungnya, kan?

column1: Although you are indeed very powerful, we have the Commander directing us.
column2: Meski kau memang sangat kuat, kami punya Commander yang mengarahkan kami.

column1: And the AR Team's strongest coordination, don't think you can beat us!
column2: Dan koordinasi terkuat AR Team, jangan pikir kau bisa mengalahkan kami!

column1: That is the truth, you... have failed.
column2: Itu kenyataannya, kau... sudah gagal.

column1: Failed... I failed?
column2: Gagal... aku gagal?

column1: Then, will I die?
column2: Kalau begitu, apa aku akan mati?

column1: (Ateraxis continuously tries to prop her body up from the ground, but her strength is unprecedentedly weak, unable to even support herself.)
column2: (Ateraxis terus mencoba menopang tubuhnya dari tanah, tapi tenaganya lemah seperti belum pernah sebelumnya, bahkan tidak sanggup menahan dirinya sendiri.)

column1: (Watching the struggling Ateraxis, Asteria grasps the Mark of the Avenger and walks toward her.)
column2: (Menatap Ateraxis yang meronta, Asteria menggenggam Mark of the Avenger dan melangkah ke arahnya.)

column1: Of course, what you and your pets did to the people of Mokosh, and what you did to the Commander and our companions on The Elmo...
column2: Tentu saja, apa yang kau dan hewan peliharaanmu lakukan pada orang-orang Mokosh, dan apa yang kau lakukan pada Commander serta rekan-rekan kami di The Elmo...

column1: I will do it myself. As a final mercy, I won't let you suffer.
column2: Aku yang akan melakukannya sendiri. Sebagai belas kasih terakhir, aku tidak akan membuatmu tersiksa.

column1: Dying here? Failing to understand Lunasia... Can I only leave it to Mother, and the children after her?
column2: Mati di sini? Gagal memahami Lunasia... Apa aku hanya bisa menyerahkannya pada Mother, dan anak-anak setelahnya?

column1: No, I am an existence that can threaten her... There must be some reason for this.
column2: Tidak, aku eksistensi yang bisa mengancamnya... Pasti ada alasan untuk itu.

column1: So, I absolutely... cannot fail just like this.
column2: Jadi aku sama sekali... tidak boleh gagal begitu saja.

column1: (Ateraxis falls backward onto the ground, but does not stop moving as we thought she would.)
column2: (Ateraxis jatuh telentang ke tanah, tapi tidak berhenti bergerak seperti dugaan kami.)

column1: (On the contrary, countless white tentacles suddenly erupt from beneath her body, lifting her high into the air.)
column2: (Sebaliknya, sulur-sulur putih yang tak terhitung tiba-tiba meletus dari bawah tubuhnya, mengangkatnya tinggi ke udara.)

column1: If I assimilate with Nirvana, I'll be able to understand Lunasia better, right?
column2: Kalau aku berasimilasi dengan Nirvana, aku akan lebih memahami Lunasia, kan?

column1: I want to go in there too...
column2: Aku juga ingin masuk ke sana...

column1: Wait—no!
column2: Tunggu—jangan!

column1: No need to waste words with her! M4, I'll do it!
column2: Tidak perlu membuang kata dengannya! M4, aku yang lakukan!

column1: (Asteria pulled the trigger aiming at Ateraxis's chest—based on previous battles, we already knew that was Ateraxis's 'core' and her only weak point.)
column2: (Asteria menarik pelatuk membidik dada Ateraxis—dari pertempuran sebelumnya, kami sudah tahu itu 'inti' Ateraxis dan satu-satunya titik lemahnya.)

column1: (However, the beam that could shoot down a dragon from afar was blocked by the phantoms on Ateraxis's body surface—the emerging shadows blocked it with their physical bodies.)
column2: (Namun sinar yang bisa menjatuhkan naga dari jauh itu ditahan oleh fantom di permukaan tubuh Ateraxis—bayangan yang menyembul itu menahannya dengan tubuh mereka sendiri.)

column1: ...Still couldn't avoid it? What an overly strong obsession.
column2: ...Tetap tidak bisa dihindari? Obsesi yang terlalu kuat.

column1: See... as expected, as long as I accept it—I can also control these powers!
column2: Lihat... sudah kuduga, selama aku menerimanya—aku juga bisa mengendalikan kekuatan ini!

column1: I can do it, Commander, in order to...
column2: Aku bisa, Commander, demi...

column1: What's going on!?
column2: Ada apa ini!?

column1: (Suddenly, a massive amount of scarlet matter surges from Ateraxis's body, and her eyes erupt with blinding light in an instant. The energy bursting from within her knocks the scarred frames of the AR Team to the ground.)
column2: (Tiba-tiba materi merah menyala dalam jumlah masif menyembur dari tubuh Ateraxis, dan matanya meletus dengan cahaya menyilaukan dalam sekejap. Energi yang meledak dari dalam dirinya menjatuhkan frame AR Team yang penuh luka ke tanah.)

column1: (A heterogeneous howl escaped from Ateraxis's slightly parted lips, then turned into a mournful wail, followed by a thousand echoes—there were low whimpers, loud roars, ethereal cries, and many ghostly sounds that didn't seem to come from living creatures.)
column2: (Lolongan yang asing lolos dari bibir Ateraxis yang terbuka sedikit, lalu berubah menjadi ratapan duka, disusul seribu gaung—ada rengekan rendah, raungan keras, tangisan yang halus, dan banyak bunyi bak hantu yang sepertinya bukan berasal dari makhluk hidup.)

column1: (Ateraxis's body was dragged up by those substances. She tried to control it, struggled, and then desperately tried to escape. Her slender limbs twisted violently, but she was completely powerless to change anything.)
column2: (Tubuh Ateraxis ditarik naik oleh materi-materi itu. Dia mencoba mengendalikannya, meronta, lalu mati-matian mencoba kabur. Tungkainya yang lentik terpuntir keras, tapi dia sepenuhnya tak berdaya mengubah apa pun.)

column1: In order to borrow the power of Nirvana, this child chose to assimilate with ██—
column2: Demi meminjam kekuatan Nirvana, anak ini memilih berasimilasi dengan ██—

column1: However, Nirvana is formed by the aggregation of countless ████. While gaining power, it is inevitable to be invaded by a large amount of ████, and this... is exactly the will of the Boojum cells in her body.
column2: Namun Nirvana terbentuk dari kumpulan ████ yang tak terhitung. Saat memperoleh kekuatan, tidak terhindarkan dia diserbu ████ dalam jumlah besar, dan ini... tepatnya kehendak sel Boojum di tubuhnya.

column1: Wha...?
No, that's not right... that's not right... you mean, I... was... by ██...
column2: Tidak, itu tidak benar... itu tidak benar... maksudmu, aku... sudah... oleh ██...

column1: Although these cells only possess instinct, you have been influenced by these instincts—just like humans whose thoughts are swayed by desires.
column2: Meski sel-sel itu hanya punya insting, kau sudah dipengaruhi insting itu—sama seperti manusia yang pikirannya digoyang hasrat.

column1: Did your 'Mother' ever tell you what so-called self-consciousness really is?
column2: Apa 'Mother'-mu pernah memberitahumu apa sebenarnya yang disebut kesadaran diri?

column1: Mother, said... the consciousness of life cannot be completely separated from the body—Ugh, waaaah!
column2: Mother, bilang... kesadaran kehidupan tidak bisa sepenuhnya dipisahkan dari tubuh—Ugh, huwaaa!

column1: No, don't come in!
column2: Jangan, jangan masuk!

column1: (The substances wrapped around Ateraxis's body revealed faces—they seemed to have absorbed Ateraxis's power, and the images they formed were no longer so chaotic. Some even looked like people I knew, reaching out countless arms like drowning victims, tearing at Ateraxis's body.)
column2: (Materi yang membelit tubuh Ateraxis memperlihatkan wajah-wajah—mereka sepertinya sudah menyerap kekuatan Ateraxis, dan citra yang mereka bentuk tidak lagi sekacau itu. Sebagian bahkan tampak seperti orang yang kukenal, mengulurkan tangan tak terhitung seperti orang tenggelam, mencabik tubuh Ateraxis.)

column1: (The AR Team supports each other to stand up, raising their weapons at the sight before them, but not knowing what to do.)
column2: (AR Team saling menopang untuk berdiri, mengangkat senjata mereka ke pemandangan di depan, tapi tidak tahu harus apa.)

column1: (Ateraxis's body is now completely enveloped and swollen by those substances. At this moment, she is like a grand amalgamation of all the terrifying incarnations in the world. Millions of faces and expressions flit across the surface, and humanoid yet non-human limbs extend in all directions, propping the already endlessly massive entity even higher and larger.)
column2: (Tubuh Ateraxis kini sepenuhnya terbungkus dan membengkak oleh materi-materi itu. Saat ini dia seperti gabungan agung dari semua penjelmaan mengerikan di dunia. Jutaan wajah dan ekspresi berkelebat di permukaannya, dan tungkai yang mirip manusia tapi bukan manusia memanjang ke segala arah, menopang entitas yang sudah masif tanpa batas itu makin tinggi dan makin besar.)

column1: Can this be called self-destruction? If we just leave her alone, will she burst herself open?
column2: Ini bisa disebut menghancurkan diri sendiri? Kalau kita biarkan saja, apa dia akan meledak sendiri?

column1: I don't think it's that simple. Instead, it looks like she's about to turn into a monster...
column2: Kurasa tidak sesederhana itu. Justru kelihatannya dia akan berubah menjadi monster...

column1: W-who are you? Go away—
column2: S-siapa kalian? Pergi—

column1: I don't need it, I don't need you guys...
column2: Aku tidak butuh itu, aku tidak butuh kalian...

column1: I am, I am Ateraxis... I'm not? I am... who... am I...?
column2: Aku, aku Ateraxis... Bukan? Aku... siapa... aku...?

column1: Ah, aaaaah—!!! No, no!!!
column2: Ah, aaaaah—!!! Tidak, tidak!!!

column1: Commander, everyone, please step back.
column2: Commander, semuanya, tolong menyingkir ke belakang.

column1: (Amidst Ateraxis's tragic cries, which were ravaged and masked by countless voices and could no longer be heard clearly, M4 raised her hand. The solid ground beneath our feet began to vibrate, and streaks of white light wrapped around Ateraxis, who was already a massive entity, dragging her downwards.)
column2: (Di tengah tangisan tragis Ateraxis yang dirusak dan ditutupi suara-suara tak terhitung sampai tidak bisa didengar jelas, M4 mengangkat tangannya. Tanah padat di bawah kaki kami mulai bergetar, dan garis-garis cahaya putih membelit Ateraxis yang sudah jadi entitas masif itu, menariknya ke bawah.)

column1: At this point, she can only be excised from this space. Before her consciousness is completely swallowed—I must keep this creation away from everything.
column2: Sampai di titik ini, dia hanya bisa dipotong dari ruang ini. Sebelum kesadarannya ditelan sepenuhnya—aku harus menjauhkan ciptaan ini dari segalanya.

column1: M4, what is this...
column2: M4, ini apa...

column1: I'm sorry... Nirvana is not some divine realm, but merely a sorrowful tomb at the end of time.
column2: Maafkan aku... Nirvana bukan ranah ilahi, hanya makam penuh duka di ujung waktu.

column1: Those who try to lay their hands on this place, no matter their original intentions, will only meet destruction in the end.
column2: Mereka yang mencoba mengulurkan tangan ke tempat ini, apa pun niat awalnya, hanya akan menemui kehancuran di akhir.

column1: (Suddenly, the massive entity seemed to sense M4's actions and struggled violently. The world beneath our feet began to overturn, the ambiguous sky and earth pulled and churned by its movements. My sight and hearing felt as if they were being utterly destroyed, like tumbling helplessly in a boiling furnace.)
column2: (Tiba-tiba entitas masif itu seolah merasakan tindakan M4 dan meronta keras. Dunia di bawah kaki kami mulai terjungkir, langit dan bumi yang samar itu tertarik dan teraduk oleh gerakannya. Penglihatan dan pendengaranku terasa seperti dihancurkan habis, seperti terguling tak berdaya di dalam tungku yang mendidih.)

column1: No... Her consciousness can actually endure to this extent. Commander, I have to send you back first—
column2: Tidak... Kesadarannya ternyata bisa bertahan sampai sejauh itu. Commander, aku harus mengirimmu balik lebih dulu—

column1: (M4 helped me up and retreated with the AR Team. Just at that moment, a somewhat familiar figure appeared within that massive entity.)
column2: (M4 membantuku berdiri dan mundur bersama AR Team. Tepat saat itu, sebuah figur yang agak kukenal muncul di dalam entitas masif itu.)

column1: (It was a girl even smaller than when we first met—the original Ateraxis, reaching out her hand to me in a pleading manner.)
column2: (Itu seorang gadis yang bahkan lebih kecil dari saat kami pertama bertemu—Ateraxis yang asli, mengulurkan tangannya kepadaku seolah memohon.)

column1: Please...
column2: Kumohon...

column1: (I instinctively respond to her action and raise my hand, even though it's not a distance I can reach. But her posture of asking for help makes me think of Helena and Melanie.)
column2: (Secara refleks aku menanggapi gerakannya dan mengangkat tanganku, meski itu bukan jarak yang bisa kujangkau. Tapi posturnya yang meminta tolong itu mengingatkanku pada Helena dan Melanie.)

column1: (Ateraxis's eyes widen, and she stares at me desperately. Even though our hands don't touch, her body seems to be gradually dragged out of that massive aggregated entity by me.)
column2: (Mata Ateraxis membelalak, dan dia menatapku dengan putus asa. Meski tangan kami tidak bersentuhan, tubuhnya seolah berangsur tertarik keluar dari entitas gabungan masif itu olehku.)

column1: (As if her consciousness has connected with my will.)
column2: (Seolah kesadarannya sudah tersambung dengan kehendakku.)

column1: Commander, you mustn't—
column2: Commander, jangan—

column1: (After saying something to me with her last bit of strength, the petite Ateraxis suddenly flew out of that entity and crashed into my arms—then vanished, like a phantom bubble.)
column2: (Setelah mengatakan sesuatu padaku dengan sisa tenaganya, Ateraxis yang kecil itu tiba-tiba terbang keluar dari entitas tersebut dan jatuh ke pelukanku—lalu hilang, seperti gelembung fana.)

column1: (The churning entity, however, stabilized as a result. Like a giant with a shell made of the abyss, it slowly stood up, stretching itself with all its might, destroying everything within its reach—)
column2: (Entitas yang teraduk itu justru menjadi stabil karenanya. Seperti raksasa bercangkang jurang, ia perlahan berdiri, meregangkan dirinya sekuat tenaga, menghancurkan segalanya dalam jangkauannya—)

column1: (M4A1 has to protect us as we step back step by step, until that entity finally tears apart the spatial dimension beneath our feet. It falls down without any scruples, heading to the deepest part of the bottom of Nirvana, seemingly deliberately wanting to lurk and hide there, accumulating power—)
column2: (M4A1 harus melindungi kami sembari kami mundur setapak demi setapak, sampai entitas itu akhirnya mencabik dimensi ruang di bawah kaki kami. Ia jatuh tanpa sungkan, menuju bagian terdalam dasar Nirvana, seolah sengaja ingin mengendap dan bersembunyi di sana, mengumpulkan kekuatan—)

column1: (And we also lose our only foothold. M4A1 floats in the air of Nirvana, grabbing Beluga's hand, while Beluga grabs Robella, and Robella grabs Soppo—)
column2: (Dan kami juga kehilangan satu-satunya pijakan. M4A1 mengapung di udara Nirvana, menggenggam tangan Beluga, sementara Beluga menggenggam Robella, dan Robella menggenggam Soppo—)

column1: Commander! Grab me!!
column2: Commander! Pegang tanganku!!

column1: (At the very end, I only hear Asteria's urgent shout. She shakes off the others' rescue and desperately tries to grab my hand, but misses by a hair's breadth, turning into a hopeless wail.)
column2: (Di ujung segalanya, aku hanya mendengar teriakan mendesak Asteria. Dia melepaskan diri dari uluran yang lain dan mati-matian mencoba menggenggam tanganku, tapi luput sehelai rambut, lalu berubah menjadi ratapan tanpa harapan.)

column1: (Then, I fall in the same direction as the thing that was once Ateraxis headed.)
column2: (Lalu aku jatuh ke arah yang sama dengan tujuan benda yang dulunya Ateraxis.)

column1: (Only a touch of blue butterfly shadow follows me unswervingly, accompanying me, heading together to that unknown end.)
column2: (Hanya sesentuh bayangan kupu-kupu biru yang mengikutiku tanpa berpaling, menemaniku, menuju bersama ke ujung yang tidak diketahui itu.)

column1: (—It's those 'phantoms'!)
column2: (—Itu 'fantom' itu!)

column1: (The phantoms that should have already been cleared out by me and the AR Team have somehow spawned many more, even climbing onto Ateraxis's body—just as I feared, they begin to entangle and assimilate with Ateraxis.)
column2: (Fantom yang seharusnya sudah dibersihkan aku dan AR Team entah bagaimana bertambah banyak, bahkan memanjat ke tubuh Ateraxis—seperti yang kutakutkan, mereka mulai membelit dan berasimilasi dengan Ateraxis.)

column1: (Heterogeneous syllables begin to appear in their conversation. They are nouns that I can neither understand nor even think about without causing a loss of consciousness.)
column2: (Suku kata yang asing mulai muncul dalam percakapan mereka. Itu kata-kata yang tidak bisa kupahami, bahkan tidak bisa kupikirkan tanpa membuatku kehilangan kesadaran.)

column1: (Those are concepts that can only be used for communication between non-human existences, between those who have seen things I cannot see.)
column2: (Itu konsep yang hanya bisa dipakai untuk komunikasi antara eksistensi non-manusia, antara mereka yang pernah melihat hal-hal yang tidak bisa kulihat.)
